note: Neutral Rust Dragon (CRsDgn.DEF). Mesh: Meshy-7 regen (identity_regen task 01a0e178, concept_edit_a2 drawn from the CRsDgn 02_00 + 08_00 plates; supersedes the CRDRGN-derived red concept), installed with install_mesh.py and scaled to 1.7. It sits upright on its haunches like the DEF idle, forelimbs raised before the chest, wings folded half-raised and swept back. Own joints and wing regions; body hand-keyed and wing anim written by handoffs/neutral_tools/azure_dragon_hand_keys.py h3_rust_dragon, which re-bases the azure poses on this upright rest (rest = the sit pose).

glbPatch.reason: DEF g00 move: the dragon flies low and level - body lifted off the floor and horizontal, neck stretched forward with the head level at the travel; ours crouched with the chest up and the head held high on a vertical neck. Lift the body 0.30, level the chest (Spine2), stretch the neck forward and level the head; MoveStart lifts into it, MoveEnd settles out. Idle breathes (Spine2/Neck/Head) instead of a dead hold.
